Later, `redhare.` notes, *\"wow tournament legend dgeist is part of the staff.\"* dgeist doesn’t engage with the server’s endless stream of slurs, femboy memes, or tech-elitism. He drops into the \"bar,\" states his business, asserts his credentials without bragging, and leaves. He represents the established *osu!* institution briefly visiting the underground rebel base.\n\n---\n\n### Part 2: Evaluation of the Core Participants\n\nIf the BPM server is a \"zoo\" (as the owner calls it), these are its primary exhibits. While the owner provides the funding, `0...0` provides the pulse. He is constantly herding cats—trying to get people to join *Terraria*, *Risk of Rain*, and the weekly *osu!* lobbies. His epic, surreal argument with `doofusgoofus10` over whether a frog\u0027s \"lily pad\" is better than a penguin\u0027s \"ice fortress\" showcases his mastery of absurd banter. He uses the edgy, degenerate persona as a shield, but his underlying goal is always to keep the community active and engaged.\n\n**2. arkheseautou (Goodnight / Mocne Dubeltowe / \"Daddy\")**\n*   **Style:** Abrasive, dismissive, authoritative, and financially secure. He communicates in short, blunt sentences, often threatening to ban people or expressing deep disappointment in his own server.\n*   **Evaluation:** He plays the classic \"grumpy landlord.\" He suffers from RSI and can barely play *osu!* anymore, yet he funds the team\u0027s expansion by buying supporter tags. He claims to hate the \"retards\" and \"15-year-olds\" in the chat, but he spends his time configuring local AI bots (`Nano Banana` / `Zercy_mero`) just to troll them. His toxicity is a love language; he complains about the server but actively enables its existence. \n\n**3. rabusu**\n*   **Style:** Arrogant, brutally pragmatic, and technically obsessed. He operates entirely on logic and efficiency. \n*   **Evaluation:** Rabusu views himself as intellectually superior to the \"zoo.\" He refuses to engage in the \"e-kitten\" roleplay, shuts down dumb ideas instantly, and is obsessed with automation. However, his cold exterior cracks when it comes to technology or his own creations. He spends 300€ on a 0.6kg \"brick\" of a phone just for the 22,000 mAh battery, proving he is just as eccentric as the people he mocks. He represents the hardcore, uncompromising developer archetype.\n\n**4. ludio235**\n*   **Style:** Intensely pedantic, deeply knowledgeable, Linux-supremacist. \n*   **Evaluation:** Ludio is the server\u0027s resident open-source zealot. He will casually derail the chat for hours to debate the merits of `systemd` vs. `runit`, the horrors of `bash` syntax, or the bloated nature of KDE Plasma. He takes pride in using a 7-year-old phone with exactly 4 apps installed. Unlike Rabusu’s aggressive elitism, Ludio’s elitism is joyful—he genuinely loves discussing obscure functional programming languages (like Haskell) and views modern tech conveniences as a corporate plague.\n\n**5. yogakin (YoganSushi)**\n*   **Style:** Loud, drunken, aggressively friendly, and wildly unfiltered (he abuses the N-word and edgy slurs constantly, claiming it\u0027s \"for the memes\").\n*   **Evaluation:** The 24-year-old Italian-Canadian acts as the ultimate \"tavern regular.\" He literally drinks alongside the chat (tracking his BAC via how many beers he’s downed) and treats the Discord like a local pub. Despite the extreme edginess, he is incredibly supportive of other players\u0027 *osu!* journeys. His 5 AM heart-to-heart with the 17-year-old `flawers0`—discussing the bleakness of modern dating, career anxiety, and the transition into adulthood—shows a surprising depth and genuine mentorship behind his \"drunk racist\" facade. \n\n**6. menze (-MenZ-)**\n*   **Style:** Hyper-submissive, emoji-spamming (`👉 👈`, `🥰`, `🫦`), intentionally provocative.\n*   **Evaluation:** Menze weaponizes the \"e-kitten\" / \"bottom\" trope to perfection. By constantly acting submissive, begging for \"Daddies,\" and pretending to be brain-damaged, he acts as a perfect comedic foil to the aggressive, hyper-masculine posturing of Goodnight, doofusgoofus, and rabusu. It is an elaborate, highly effective form of trolling that successfully disarms the server\u0027s tension.\n\n**7. doofusgoofus10**\n*   **Style:** Combative, zoomer-brained, deeply antagonistic.\n*   **Evaluation:** He is the primary instigator. Whether he is shitting on the server\u0027s moderation, starting massive flame wars about penguins, or arguing over C vs. Zig programming, he thrives on conflict. He represents the restless, high-energy teenage demographic of the *osu!* scene that requires constant stimulation and pushback to stay entertained.\n\n### Synthesis of the Server Culture\nBPM is a community running on **\"Dead Internet Theory\" energy**. They constantly complain that the \"chat is dead,\" yet they output nearly 10,000 messages of dense, hyper-specific dialogue. They use racial slurs, extreme irony, and aggressive insults to gatekeep the community, ensuring only those who can handle the \"heat\" stick around. However, beneath the layer of furry-porn jokes and tech-elitism, there is a fierce, almost touching camaraderie.         "text": " rank. If you are a \"7-digit with single digits of playtime\" or play \"aim slop,\" you are on"
      }, {
        "text": " the chopping block.\n*   **The Inference:** This mechanic turns the server into a meritocracy heavily weighted by financial contribution"
      }, {
        "text": ". Rabusu’s bot is the ultimate judge, jury, and executioner, completely automating the social hierarchy of the clan"
      }, {
        "text": ".\n\n### 2. The Ethics of Tournament Organization\nThe planning of the **BPM x THSL Collab Tournament** exposes"
      }, {
        "text": " a massive philosophical divide between the mods regarding how *osu!* events should be run.\n*   **Rabusu (The"
      }, {
        "text": " Purist):** He views tournaments as sacred, meritocratic systems. He violently opposes the idea of tournament organizers playing in"
      }, {
        "text": " their own event, arguing it compromises competitive integrity. He believes that even if organizers don\u0027t explicitly rig the mappool, the *"
      }, {
        "text": "perception* of unfairness will ruin the event. He wants mathematically randomized teams and strict skill filtering via qualifiers.\n*   **0"
      }, {
        "text": "_____________________________.0 \u0026 hydrangeaze (The Casuals):** They view the tournament as a community-building party"
      }, {
        "text": ". `0...0` flat out says, \"no person in their right mind would do this just for the love of this particular"
      }, {
        "text": " team... it\u0027s no fun [if I can\u0027t play].\" \n*   **The Resolution:** The casual"
      }, {
        "text": "s win. The final pinned announcement explicitly states: *\"all players from the clans are eligible to participate; even the sponsors and tourney organizers"
      }, {
        "text": ".\"* Rabusu’s rigid ethics are overruled by the community\u0027s desire to just hang out and play the game.\n\n###"
      }, {
        "text": " 3. The Moderation Civil War\nThe tension over what is acceptable behavior reaches a boiling point in this channel, perfectly"
      }, {
        "text": " contextualizing the complaints seen in the public `Bar / chat` logs.\n*   **Goodnight’s Breaking"
      }, {
        "text": " Point:** `arkheseautou` (Goodnight) is the exhausted owner. He suffers from RSI, barely plays the"
      }, {
        "text": " game anymore, and is actively looking to pass ownership to `0...0` or `hydrangeaze`. However, before"
      }, {
        "text": " he steps down, he enforces a strict automod against racial slurs. His reasoning is simple: *\"I\u0027m not"
      }, {
        "text": " gonna be a nazi discord mod but I don\u0027t want to cringe when looking through the server... Just because you can say nigga doesn\u0027t"
      }, {
        "text": " make you cool. Shit is just edgy.\"*\n*   **The Pushback:** The rest of the mod team"
      }, {
        "text": " (`0...0`, `rabusu`, `ludio235`) actively resents this. They view the slur"
      }, {
        "text": " automod as \"1984\" overreach in a server that prides itself on having \"no rules.\""
      }, {
        "text": " \n*   **The Shadowban System:** To deal with players they genuinely hate (like `imhard`, the obnoxious"
      }, {
        "text": " 7-digit aim player), Rabusu programs a \"Blacklist\" into the bot. Rather than openly banning them"
      }, {
        "text": ", the bot essentially locks them in the `#verify` channel forever—a digital purgatory that Rabusu admits is \"evil"
      }, {
        "text": " by definition,\" but implements anyway for \"greedy personal satisfaction.\"\n\n### 4. Character Evolutions in the Backroom"
      }, {
        "text": "\n\n*   **Rabusu:** The log confirms he is the server\u0027s indispensable linchpin. He writes the SQL"
      }, {
        "text": ", manages the Postgres database, deploys the code, and debugs API bottlenecks. He leverages this technical monopoly to act"
      }, {
        "text": " with impunity—openly deleting other mods\u0027 messages if they annoy him and threatening to withhold his bot if his demands aren\u0027t met"
      }, {
        "text": ". He is the classic \"rogue IT guy.\"\n*   **hydrangeaze (Mercy_zero):** Acts as"
      }, {
        "text": " the mature, stabilizing project manager. When Rabusu complains about Railway\u0027s free-tier server limits, `hydrangeaze` immediately offers to rent"
      }, {
        "text": " a VPS and grant SSH access. When Rabusu and `0...0` bicker over channel layouts or tournament rules, `hydrangeaze"
      }, {
        "text": "` is the one who steps in to say \"no more drama\" and forces them to compromise.\n*   **flawers"
      }, {
        "text": "0:** The THSL clan leader proves to be incredibly chill. While BPM\u0027s mods over-engineer the tournament with APIs"
      }, {
        "text": " and strict seeding, `flawers0` steps into their backroom and suggests they just play a \"chill lobby with meme maps\" and maybe"
      }, {
        "text": " host a cultural exchange. THSL acts as the grounded, well-adjusted foil to BPM\u0027s hyper-analytical chaos.\n\n### Summary\nThe"
      }, {
        "text": " `mod-chat` reveals that BPM is basically held together by duct tape, API calls, and fragile truces. The technical"
      }, {
        "text": " ambition of the server vastly outpaces its actual size, resulting in a fascinating scenario where teenage and early-20s gamers"
      }, {
        "text": " are designing automated SQL-driven bureaucracies just to manage a friend-group\u0027s *osu!* lobby."

      "text": "\n\n\nBased on the provided chat logs and his footprint in the broader *osu!* community, **dGeist** is a highly respected veteran tournament organizer, referee, and mappool selector (often referred to as a \"pooler\"). \n\nWhile he has been involved in the traditional *osu!stable* tournament scene for years, he is currently best known as **one of the primary pioneers of *osu!lazer* tournaments.**\n\nHere is a breakdown of who he is and why he is considered a \"legend\" in the scene right now:\n\n**1.
